alierayyagiyanik: Tobias "Ash" Alierayyagiy came from Dunmarrow, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people. The machine gunners took Tobias "Ash" Alierayyagiy in on a busy morning in R-C11. By noon he had learned the first rule of the job, and by evening the second.

The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Tobias "Ash" Alierayyagiy read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Tobias "Ash" Alierayyagiy. Tobias "Ash" Alierayyagiy read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The gun team argued about who carried the heaviest load. Tobias "Ash" Alierayyagiy offered to swap loads. The argument ended at once. The clerk counted the names twice. Tobias "Ash" Alierayyagiy is number 613 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Tobias "Ash" Alierayyagiy kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
Frost on the wire made it sing in the wind. Tobias "Ash" Alierayyagiy could not stop listening to it.
Tobias "Ash" Alierayyagiy was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success.
At R-C11 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Tobias "Ash" Alierayyagiy won the bet. Viktor Mujtaba was gravely wounded.

Tobias "Ash" Alierayyagiy saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at R-C11 and fired once. Ulrich Hodnepijumal was grazed. The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Tobias "Ash" Alierayyagiy waited for that to change. When it did, Oskar "Ash" Kvasnicka was grazed.
Tobias "Ash" Alierayyagiy had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Severin Ali was badly wounded.
The gun at R-C11 jammed twice and fired once. Once was enough: Gustav "Doc" Dawgdawghuuu, grazed.
Tobias was ordered to hold fire until the signal. He waited with a finger on the trigger and a sweat on his neck.
asdf51647: Jakub Asdf unpacked a tin of tobacco at U-F2. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.

Arno Passenger of the Hegemony and Jakub Asdf of the Concord have been shooting at the same tin can on the wire at Lantern Hill for a week. Both trenches keep score. Grey Mill is lost. Jakub Asdf heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Jakub Asdf received the rank of Lance Corporal and a stack of unfinished paperwork. The congratulations lasted less time than the paperwork.
Jakub Asdf measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together.
Roland "Button" Lahetta and Jakub Asdf compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at U-F2 and grazed Jakub Asdf's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Felix "Mud" Goat of the Hegemony (@eli_is_a_goat).
Jakub Asdf returned to U-F2 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part.
Jakub Asdf and Viktor Avery spent an hour hunting rats with a bucket and a piece of cheese. Score at dusk: rats 4, soldiers 1.
Jakub traded half a ration of tobacco for a better rifle oil. The deal was fair, and nobody else would have made it.
ba_ba_ba_batman: Casimir "Button" Batman reached R-F7 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.

Casimir "Button" Batman read a letter that said the neighbour had married again. The whole dugout wanted the missing first half of the story. Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Casimir "Button" Batman watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Casimir "Button" Batman changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument.
Norbert Slc lent Casimir "Button" Batman a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'.

Casimir "Button" Batman borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Hill 304. Casimir "Button" Batman read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Casimir "Button" Batman asked if second helpings depended on the answer.
An old advertisement showed a spotless man smoking beside a fireplace. Casimir "Button" Batman added a leak above the man's head in pencil.

A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Casimir "Button" Batman across the shin at R-F7. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Ivo "Bones" Rylan of the Hegemony (@rylan_45h). Mail came up the line with a letter for Casimir "Button" Batman. Casimir "Button" Batman read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Machine-gun fire swept R-F7. Casimir "Button" Batman took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Teodor Shadowizard of the Hegemony (@shadowizard__). Casimir "Button" Batman was killed outright at R-F7, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Teodor Shadowizard of the Hegemony (@shadowizard__).
The papers connected Emil Batman to Casimir "Button" Batman. The men took longer to learn Emil Batman's own habits, but they made the effort.
The Hegemony raiders were in and out in two minutes. At R-F7 they left Emil Batman behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Isidor "Tin" Brayden of the Hegemony (@brayden27727).
Zeno "Hollow" Batman arrived carrying the family name of Emil Batman. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.

A bullet grazed Zeno "Hollow" Batman's ribs at R-F7. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Henrik "Mud" Tiberiuswt of the Hegemony (@tiberiuswt). The clerk counted the names twice. Zeno "Hollow" Batman is number 153 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached R-F7 with the rations. Zeno "Hollow" Batman ate while listening to the revised orders.
Zeno "Hollow" Batman no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.

Zeno "Hollow" Batman and Jonas Steini carved a chess set out of candle wax. The kings melted too close to the stove, so the game goes on without them. Mail came up the line with a letter for Zeno "Hollow" Batman. Zeno "Hollow" Batman read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Zeno "Hollow" Batman read a theatre review while peeling supper.
A story about a goat passed through three dugouts and reached Zeno "Hollow" Batman as a story about a general. The ending was the same.

At R-F7 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Zeno "Hollow" Batman turned around and took a shovel blow. Otto Tyner of the Hegemony was already gone. Raider: Otto Tyner of the Hegemony (@tyner_1776).
Zeno "Hollow" Batman sat out the day with a bandaged arm, cleaning every rifle within reach. It was the only job the medic would allow.

A bullet found Zeno at R-F7, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Bram Toaster of the Hegemony (@glorified_toaster). A man in the field hospital died before dawn, and his bed went to Zeno. Nobody pretends that is not how it works.
calderthebald: Benedikt Calderthebal arrived on Day 4 as a replacement. The men in R-F5 had been fighting for 3 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.

Benedikt Calderthebal and Yann "Tin" Verstlisaver tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco. Mail came up the line with a letter for Benedikt Calderthebal. Benedikt Calderthebal read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Benedikt Calderthebal raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F5. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Rafael "Shadow" Gavinlordofp of the Concord (@gavinlordofpugs). Day 6. The Hegemony took Hill 304. From the heights Benedikt Calderthebal could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Benedikt Calderthebal's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
Benedikt Calderthebal stood at the parapet at dawn with the rest of R-F5, bayonet fixed, staring into the grey. Nothing came. Nothing came yesterday, either.
Benedikt Calderthebal was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success.
Benedikt Calderthebal ended a letter with 'nothing to report', then added half a page about the missing soap.

The Concord raiders came over at R-F5 in the middle of the night. Benedikt Calderthebal met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Tobias Georgia of the Concord (@channel17georgia).
Rafael "Spark" Calderthebal joined R-F5 under the shadow of Benedikt Calderthebal's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.

Rafael "Spark" Calderthebal carved his initials into the trench wall next to a hundred others. Some of them are only half finished. Rafael "Spark" Calderthebal got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 239. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Rafael "Spark" Calderthebal helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Rafael "Spark" Calderthebal began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else.
Rafael "Spark" Calderthebal found a shirt button in the bread. He ate around it and kept the button. Both were useful.
Word of Rafael "Spark" Calderthebal's blanket spread. A strip of lining and a square from an old scarf arrived without explanation.
A bullet went through Rafael "Spark" Calderthebal's sleeve at R-F5 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Dorian Joshgentile of the Concord (@joshgentile80).
Rafael "Spark" Calderthebal walked back up the communication trench to R-F5, slower than before, but on his own feet.
Rafael "Spark" Calderthebal finished the blanket using six kinds of cloth. The men can identify most of the donors by the patches alone.
The patched blanket kept Rafael warm through the night. In the morning, a neighbour arrived with another torn blanket and an optimistic expression.
calin._av: On Day 5 Arno "Rabbit" Calin took a post at R-F23 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He sleeps with his boots on, and the men liked him for it.

A bullet found Arno "Rabbit" Calin at R-F23, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Arno "Smokes" Den of the Concord (@ay.den0707). Arno "Rabbit" Calin walked the captured trenches of Hill 304 and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Arno "Rabbit" Calin died on a stretcher outside the aid post, still waiting for a bed. The medics had nothing left to give him.
The House of Calin sent another. Hugo Calin, older brother of Arno "Rabbit" Calin, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
Hugo Calin checked the fire step after the shelling. The wall had moved, and the spot where he always put his foot was gone.
A supply man offered Hugo Calin a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records.
Hugo Calin coaxed the gramophone into turning. It plays a waltz with a scratched introduction, but something knocks once every revolution.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at R-F23 changed before the cheering ended. Hugo Calin shouldered another load.

The gramophone stopped knocking after Hugo Calin tightened a screw. The dugout applauded the repair halfway through a waltz with a scratched introduction, spoiling the best part. The clerk counted the names twice. Hugo Calin is number 321 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Hugo Calin wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Hugo Calin delivered an urgent message and waited while the officer searched every pocket for a pencil to sign for it.
Hugo Calin passed the gramophone to the next section with a note about the screw. By evening, a waltz with a scratched introduction could be heard faintly through the wall.
Hugo Calin saved the last of the sugar for Roland Customs's birthday. Nobody knows if it really was Roland's birthday. It was a good day anyway.
Hugo Calin tried to write neatly for the first line of a letter. By the third, he was writing as quickly as the thoughts arrived.
Hugo Calin and Emil Yijoon found a cat in the ruins at Lantern Hill and argued for an hour about its name. The cat settled it by sleeping on Emil.
Hugo Calin traded a lock of hair in a matchbox for two cigarettes and immediately regretted it.
Hugo had a message for the lieutenant and found only the lieutenant's cap. The lieutenant was in the next trench. The message was delivered, late.
captain_dill_pickles23: Yann Pickles came up on Day 9 carrying news from Oakmere. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.
Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Yann Pickles shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Yann Pickles found a photograph in the mud of no man's land: a wedding party, and a name on the back that is not from his side of the wire. The clerk counted the names twice. Yann Pickles is number 777 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Yann Pickles folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
A bucket appeared above the Concord parapet at the Brickworks. Yann Pickles fired. Hugo "Lucky" Chris pulled the bucket down. Later a sign went up: 'Water costs enough already.'
Yann Pickles keeps the photograph in his pocket next to a stub of a pencil. He says he will give it back after the war. Nobody asks to whom.
Wiring party. Yann Pickles held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at S-C9, and everyone came back.
Yann Pickles left the photograph on a stake in the wire at Blackwater Canal, wrapped in oilcloth. In the morning it was gone. In its place: a single cigarette.
Yann Pickles traded a stub of a pencil for two cigarettes and immediately regretted it.
Yann Pickles hummed an old song from home on sentry. From the other side of the wire, very faintly, someone hummed it back.
Yann sang the first verse tonight, out loud. The other side sang the second. Nobody fired for an hour.
clintxix: Benedikt Clintxix reported to U-F1 with a bullet that missed him sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice. Benedikt Clintxix reported for duty as a machine gunner. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.

Benedikt Clintxix fired at the sound of digging across the wire. The digging stopped. Florian Irishman was badly wounded. Brass cases piled up around Benedikt Clintxix's boots at U-F1. Out of all those rounds, one found Oskar "Bones" Theophane, badly wounded. A letter from home reached Benedikt Clintxix before dusk. Benedikt Clintxix read it twice and slept a little easier.

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at U-F1 and grazed Benedikt Clintxix's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Tobias Realvirtuali of the Concord (@realvirtuality). A letter from home reached Benedikt Clintxix before dusk. Benedikt Clintxix read it twice and slept a little easier.

Benedikt Clintxix spent the night in no man's land with pliers and a roll of wire. Every flare meant lying flat in the mud. The gap at U-F1 is closed now. Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Benedikt Clintxix is whole again, or near enough for the line.

A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Benedikt Clintxix across the shin at U-F1. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Yann "Ash" Tons of the Concord (@tons355). A letter from home reached Benedikt Clintxix before dusk. Benedikt Clintxix read it twice and slept a little easier.

A round came through the loophole Benedikt Clintxix was watching at U-F1 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Arno "Rabbit" Snake of the Concord (@__snake__cx). The beds were full. Benedikt Clintxix waits on a stretcher in the dark with a medic's promise and a dry mouth.
Benedikt Clintxix held on as long as he could on the stretcher outside the aid post. There were not enough hands, and not enough beds.
The House of Clintxix sent another. Walter "Bones" Clintxix, father of Benedikt Clintxix, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
Walter was hit in the forearm at U-F1. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Florian Can of the Concord (@vin.can.do).
coloradoforwardblake: Dorian Coloradoforw arrived at S-R2 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.

In the dark of the Hegemony trench Dorian Coloradoforw hit Nils Noaskevitch with a trench club, then ran for the wire before the flares went up. (@noaskevitch) Dorian Coloradoforw counted the steps of the Hegemony sentry, waited for the turn, and went in. Pavel Yijoon never saw the shovel coming. (@yijoon09) Dorian Coloradoforw cut his hand to the bone on the wire at Hill 304. Iodine, a bandage, and a lecture from the medic. Blackwater Canal is lost. Dorian Coloradoforw heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Three days with a bandage, and Dorian Coloradoforw is back at S-R2. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him. A letter from home found Dorian Coloradoforw before the night shift. Dorian Coloradoforw folded it small and kept it close. After what happened at Lantern Hill, Dorian Coloradoforw asked to serve as a stretcher bearer. Nobody argued. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Dorian Coloradoforw watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Dorian Coloradoforw offered a length of string for a better place near the stove. The offer was refused with surprising dignity. A letter from home found Dorian Coloradoforw before the night shift. Dorian Coloradoforw folded it small and kept it close.
Dorian Coloradoforw and Otto Summacon made a pact: whoever gets home first visits the other's mother. They shook on it twice, to be sure.

Dorian Coloradoforw spent the night in no man's land with pliers and a roll of wire. Every flare meant lying flat in the mud. The gap at S-R2 is closed now. A letter from home found Dorian Coloradoforw before the night shift. Dorian Coloradoforw folded it small and kept it close.
Dorian Coloradoforw found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases.

Night raid. Dorian Coloradoforw crossed no man's land, saw the enemy sentry too late to reach, and came back without a scratch. Next time, says Dorian Coloradoforw. Mail came up the line with a letter for Dorian Coloradoforw. Dorian Coloradoforw read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
A borrowed pencil wore down while Dorian Coloradoforw was writing home. The last line is twice as large as the first.
Dorian carried three men out of S-R2 on a stretcher. One of them thanked him. Two could not.
coopergfulton: Arno Coopergfulto came up on Day 5 carrying news from Millbank. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.

The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Arno Coopergfulto fished it out by feel and then had to wash again. The sergeant read out the order: Hill 304 has fallen, hold the line. Arno Coopergfulto looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
A single shot from across the wire hit Arno Coopergfulto in the thigh at R-F22. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Pavel Yijoon of the Hegemony (@yijoon09).
Arno Coopergfulto drifted in and out on the stretcher. Every time he woke, the line for the beds seemed longer.
Arno Coopergfulto returned to R-F22 thinner and paler, with a wound that closed without a single night in a bed. The medics count it as one of theirs.
The whole squad at R-F22 fired five rounds rapid. The squad agrees it was Arno Coopergfulto's bullet that found Clement "Hollow" Lancegribko, grazed.

Arno Coopergfulto was cleaning the rifle when a head showed across the wire. Load, aim, fire. Wendel "Brick" Andyincorpor was grazed. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Arno Coopergfulto kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Frost on the wire made it sing in the wind. Arno Coopergfulto could not stop listening to it. Arno Coopergfulto got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 351. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into R-F22. Arno Coopergfulto has learned to walk bent double.
Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Arno Coopergfulto changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument.
Silas Menezes of the Hegemony and Arno Coopergfulto of the Concord share the same habit: a whistle at midnight. Both lines at the Chalk Pits now wait for it before they sleep.
A borrowed pencil wore down while Arno Coopergfulto was writing home. The last line is twice as large as the first.
Arno Coopergfulto saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at R-F22 and fired once. Marek Jesh was badly wounded.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Arno Coopergfulto was hit hard in the fight at R-F22 before anyone could fire. The raider was Matthias Barontheliet of the Hegemony. Raider: Matthias Barontheliet of the Hegemony (@baronthelietch).
Arno Coopergfulto spent the day on a stretcher counting the bearers who went past. Forty-three. None of them stopped.
There was never a bed for Arno, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to R-F22 on his own feet.
djsunspear: Ulrich Djsunspear took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.

A borrowed towel came back cleaner than when Ulrich Djsunspear lent it. He is considering lending out the rest of the washing. A letter from home found Ulrich Djsunspear before the night shift. Ulrich Djsunspear folded it small and kept it close. Ulrich Djsunspear walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Ulrich Djsunspear put an empty tin under a short table leg. Supper stopped sliding toward the corporal.

Ulrich Djsunspear found a flower growing out of a sandbag. He did not tell anyone. He checks on it every morning. A letter from home found Ulrich Djsunspear before the night shift. Ulrich Djsunspear folded it small and kept it close.

Ulrich Djsunspear went out with the wiring party at T-F4. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit. A letter from home found Ulrich Djsunspear before the night shift. Ulrich Djsunspear folded it small and kept it close.
A bullet clipped Ulrich Djsunspear's helmet at T-F4 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Clement William of the Concord (@william_fg9).

Ulrich Djsunspear rejoined the squad at T-F4. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there. Ulrich Djsunspear kept the new letter in a breast pocket all day, and touched the pocket now and then to check it was there.

Ulrich Djsunspear spent the afternoon delousing his shirt over a candle. The lice won on points. There was a letter for Ulrich Djsunspear. Someone at home had drawn a small picture in the corner. Ulrich Djsunspear laughed for the first time in days.

Ivo Enriquez woke Ulrich from a nightmare by calling Ulrich name. Ulrich did not say thank you, but poured the tea. A letter from home reached Ulrich before dusk. Ulrich read it twice and slept a little easier.
dominushospesii: Day 11. The corporal put Konrad "Bones" Dominushospe beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Konrad "Bones" Dominushospe shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
A one-eyed crow landed on the parapet above Konrad "Bones" Dominushospe. The men named it Inkwell and said it had chosen him.
Inkwell the crow follows Konrad "Bones" Dominushospe along the trench now. When Inkwell flies off, men duck. They are usually right to.
Henrik Damnitsamir fixed the strap on Konrad "Bones" Dominushospe's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.

Konrad "Bones" Dominushospe was carrying water up to P-F6 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Konrad "Bones" Dominushospe did not. Shot by Marek "Brick" Pyroholio of the Concord (@the_great_pyroholio). Konrad "Bones" Dominushospe was killed on watch at P-F6. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Marek "Brick" Pyroholio of the Concord (@the_great_pyroholio).
The House of Dominushospe sent another. Viktor "Button" Dominushospe, brother of Konrad "Bones" Dominushospe, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
A bullet went through Viktor "Button" Dominushospe's sleeve at P-F6 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Wendel Aokiji of the Concord (@aokiji89_).
Viktor "Button" Dominushospe rejoined the squad at P-F6. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.
Viktor and Severin Benson swapped hats for a day to see if anyone would notice. Nobody did, and both were a little insulted.
ethan_thomson97: On Day 11, Casimir "Whistle" Thomson arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.
A pocket watch went along the bench so everyone could set the time. Casimir "Whistle" Thomson has no watch, but checked it anyway, just to feel included.
A flare caught Casimir "Whistle" Thomson halfway through a yawn on the fire step. He stayed still until his jaw ached.
Blast from a trench mortar threw Casimir "Whistle" Thomson against the trench wall at N-F5. Ringing ears, a split lip, and no intention of leaving.
Back on the fire step at N-F5. Casimir "Whistle" Thomson says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign.
The cook's stew tasted of iron and smoke. Casimir "Whistle" Thomson ate two helpings anyway.
Casimir "Whistle" Thomson dreamt he was back in Old Harrow, working as a coal miner. He woke up and said nothing all morning.
Casimir was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at N-F5. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Ivo Tongantui of the Hegemony (@tongantui).
jeffwiratama: Isidor Jeffwiratama arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a photograph gone soft at the edges and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.

Shell splinters peppered S-C3. Isidor Jeffwiratama picked three out of his sleeve and a fourth out of his arm. Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Isidor Jeffwiratama wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

The medic cut the last bandage off Isidor Jeffwiratama's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to S-C3 the same hour. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Isidor Jeffwiratama answered to number 754. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Isidor Jeffwiratama watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Anselm "Tin" Belugawales and Isidor Jeffwiratama have a secret signal: two taps on the helmet means 'still here'. They use it every night after the flares go out.
Fog hid the far end of S-C3. Isidor Jeffwiratama kept counting the turns so as not to walk past the dugout.
Isidor Jeffwiratama remembered the tune but not the words. Six men offered six different songs, and none of them helped.
A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Isidor Jeffwiratama. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer.
Isidor Jeffwiratama's hands still remember being a dance-hall violinist's hands. Today they mended a broken duckboard as if it were the most important job in the world.
A splinter opened Isidor Jeffwiratama's cheek at S-C3. A medic stitched it on the spot and he was back on the fire step before the tea went cold.
The wound on Isidor's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.
kyrie_eleisson: The old hands of T-S9 have been here since Day 1. Viktor Eleisson has been here since Day 9. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.

Viktor Eleisson threw a bomb into a Hegemony dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Valentin "Ghost" Scotty was down and screaming for a medic. (@scotty01851) On the way back from the night raid a flare went up. Viktor Eleisson was caught in the open and hit before reaching the wire. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Viktor Eleisson kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Three days with a bandage, and Viktor Eleisson is back at T-S9. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him. Mail came up the line with a letter for Viktor Eleisson. Viktor Eleisson read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Viktor Eleisson wrote to twin brothers too young to enlist that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Viktor Eleisson wrote to twin brothers too young to enlist. He did not mention the shelling. He mentioned the stars.
A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Viktor Eleisson's bunk. He has named it Little Sergeant.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. Viktor Eleisson felt a hard tug at his hip at T-S9. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string.
Viktor Eleisson came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon.

The flare went up just as Viktor Eleisson reached the Hegemony parapet. Viktor Eleisson jumped down first. Oskar Mateescu was the man waiting there, and Oskar Mateescu fell. (@horatiu_mateescu) No rifles, only shovels and knives. Viktor Eleisson dropped into the Hegemony trench by a dugout door and met Yann Cnfilip coming out. It was over in seconds. (@cnfilip77)

Little Sergeant the rat now waits for Viktor Eleisson at dawn watch every morning. He shares crumbs with it. The corporal calls this desertion of rations. A letter for Viktor Eleisson came with a photograph. Viktor Eleisson looked at it for a long time and said nothing.
A bullet passed so close to Viktor at T-S9 that it burned his neck. The sergeant told him to count that as a haircut. Shot by Albin "Ghost" Thembamstel of the Hegemony (@thembamstel).
luxos8000: By the time Wendel "Whistle" Luxos reached T-F1, the war was 9 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.

The Hegemony raiders were in and out in two minutes. At T-F1 they left Wendel "Whistle" Luxos behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Isidor Stinchgaming of the Hegemony (@stinchgaming25).
The House of Luxos sent another. Marek "Saint" Luxos, older brother of Wendel "Whistle" Luxos, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.

A bullet hit Marek "Saint" Luxos's belt buckle at T-F1 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Henrik "Bones" Spencercenso of the Hegemony (@spencercensor). Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Marek "Saint" Luxos kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
The medics cleaned Marek "Saint" Luxos's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at T-F1.
Fog hid the far end of T-F1. Marek "Saint" Luxos kept counting the turns so as not to walk past the dugout.

A bullet clipped Marek "Saint" Luxos's helmet at T-F1 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Henrik "Bones" Spencercenso of the Hegemony (@spencercensor).
Marek "Saint" Luxos was hit in the hip at T-F1. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Henrik "Bones" Spencercenso of the Hegemony (@spencercensor).

Marek "Saint" Luxos's wound turned bad. The bandage was not enough and he was carried back to wait for a bed. Marek "Saint" Luxos has a bed in the hospital dugout at last, between a man who prays and a man who swears. He says it is a fair balance.
Marek "Saint" Luxos is out of the worst of it. He sleeps most of the day, and the surgeon lets him.
The field hospital let Marek go. He came back up the line on foot because the truck would not wait.
marius12214: Valentin Marius told the sergeant he was a farmhand. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.
Blackwater Canal has been won. Valentin Marius listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Valentin Marius traded a stub of a pencil for two cigarettes and immediately regretted it. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Valentin Marius wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Valentin Marius wrote to a mother who sets a place for him at every meal. He did not mention the shelling. He mentioned the stars.
The kettle lid rattled whenever the conversation stopped. Valentin Marius put a folded cloth beneath it and immediately missed the noise.
Valentin Marius (Hegemony) and Ulrich Tylerbec (Concord) ended up in the same shell hole at Lantern Hill. They stared at each other. Then each crawled home, and neither has told anyone.
Valentin Marius did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Valentin Marius fired back. Karel Tylerlockado was grazed.
Valentin Marius saved the last of the sugar for Tobias "Tin" Kaijkrause's birthday. Nobody knows if it really was Tin's birthday. It was a good day anyway.
Valentin Marius and Clement Truth tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco.
A parcel contained a bar of chocolate broken into uneven pieces. Valentin closed his eyes while someone else distributed them.
neverheavyenough: Arno Neverheavyen was a medical student in Greyhallow until the posters went up. He came to W-F10 with a rosary of rough beads, and within a day the whole squad knew that he shares cigarettes but never smokes.

Arno Neverheavyen taught Emil Masonpicco to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop. A letter for Arno Neverheavyen came all the way from home in nine days. Arno Neverheavyen counted them on the envelope.

Emil Masonpicco and Arno Neverheavyen share one pair of good gloves on watch, one glove each. It is not practical. It is friendship. There was a letter for Arno Neverheavyen and a little tobacco folded inside. The tobacco went round the squad. The letter did not.

Arno fired at the enemy dawn watch from W-F10. Tobias Simiano was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down. Arno got a letter with a recipe in it. Nobody in the trench had any of the things it needed.
olly.a2019: Tobias Olly came up with a draft of replacements on Day 10. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.

Tobias Olly and Valentin Theoneonlyfi argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In P-F19, Tobias Olly listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Tobias Olly began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else.
Word of Tobias Olly's blanket spread. A strip of lining and a square from an old scarf arrived without explanation.
Tobias Olly finished the blanket using six kinds of cloth. The men can identify most of the donors by the patches alone.

A bullet went through Tobias Olly's upper arm at P-F19 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Lucien "Hollow" Theteeternot of the Hegemony (@theteeternotharis). Tobias Olly had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Benedikt "Saint" Wilson was gravely wounded.
Tobias Olly spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice.
Tobias Olly survived the wound and the waiting. He is back at P-F19, and still will not talk about the nights outside the aid post.
The patched blanket kept Tobias warm through the night. In the morning, a neighbour arrived with another torn blanket and an optimistic expression.
person116987345686: The old hands of R-S7 have been here since Day 1. Isidor Person has been here since Day 6. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.

Isidor Person was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success. A letter from home reached Isidor Person before dusk. Isidor Person read it twice and slept a little easier.
Isidor Person and Felix "Tin" Euberitamini made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it.
The men argued about whether fish sleep. Isidor Person said yes, and was told to explain how anyone could know.
Isidor Person snores. Felix "Tin" Euberitamini does not. Tin now sleeps with a sock stuffed in each ear, and the two are still friends.
On Day 10, Blackwater Canal passed to the Hegemony. Isidor Person wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

Isidor Person got a letter from Marguerite. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Isidor Person is number 392. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Isidor Person watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
A clear shot from R-S7. Isidor Person grazed Oskar Haggis and slid back down below the parapet.
New laces made Isidor Person's boots look almost respectable, until he stood up.
Isidor Person wrote back to Marguerite and tore it up three times. The fourth version says almost nothing, which is how he knows it is the right one.

A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Isidor Person shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Edmund "Tin" Prohunterwh, was grazed. Isidor Person was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at R-S7. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Yann "Ghost" Qhmullaney of the Concord (@qhmullaney). Isidor Person looked over the parapet at R-S7 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Yann "Ghost" Qhmullaney of the Concord (@qhmullaney).
The papers connected Gideon Person to Isidor Person. The men took longer to learn Gideon Person's own habits, but they made the effort.
Gideon Person traded a cigarette for a pinch of salt. Supper improved. The argument about the exchange rate did not.
A bullet went through Gideon Person's sleeve at R-S7 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Ivo "Mud" Thompson of the Concord (@zach.thompson_74).

Gideon was hit twice in the leg at R-S7. The medic cut the trouser open with scissors and said nothing useful. Shot by Florian Luckycat of the Concord (@luckycat2025). Gideon was carried into the field hospital feet first, because that was the only way the stretcher fit through the door.
pinoy_americano: Yann Americano signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at N-F1 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
Yann Americano checked the fire step after the shelling. The wall had moved, and the spot where he always put his foot was gone.
Yann Americano's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket.
A second spoon disappeared. Yann Americano searched the washing area and found a gap behind the board where everyone left cutlery to dry.
A clear shot from N-F1. Yann grazed Edmund "Mole" Kingadaml and slid back down below the parapet.
zeek.dalton: Karel Dalton arrived at P-F22 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.
A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Karel Dalton's bunk. He has named it Duchess. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Karel Dalton wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Karel Dalton had just lit a cigarette at P-F22 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Matthias Coop of the Hegemony (@dale.coop).

A bullet went through Karel Dalton's upper arm at P-F22 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Clement Hanginbang of the Hegemony (@rusty_hanginbang). A single shot at P-F22. Karel Dalton sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Clement Hanginbang of the Hegemony (@rusty_hanginbang).
Jonas Dalton put a stub of a pencil beside the bunk. Someone who had known Karel Dalton helped clear the shelf without saying why.
A new recruit would not eat with the others. Jonas Dalton left a place at the end of the bench and said nothing about it.
A round went through the rim of Jonas Dalton's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Felix Panzerfaust of the Hegemony (@panzerfaust5803).

Jonas Dalton was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at P-F22. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Hugo Plhubs of the Hegemony (@plhubs). Jonas Dalton stood up to fix a loose sandbag at P-F22. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Hugo Plhubs of the Hegemony (@plhubs).
The House of Dalton sent Dietrich Dalton after Jonas Dalton. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
An enemy patrol scattered in front of P-F22. Dietrich Dalton fired at the last man to run. Ivo Time was grazed.
Fresh from training, Dietrich still aims the way the instructor said. Today it worked: Wendel Ztardvst, badly wounded.
